# [NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN Comparison 2026

If you're searching for the best VPN in 2026, chances are you've narrowed it down to two heavyweights: NordVPN and ExpressVPN. Both are top-tier services with millions of users worldwide, but which one actually deserves your money? In this detailed NordVPN vs ExpressVPN comparison, we'll break down everything — speed, security, pricing, streaming performance, and more — so you can make the right choice.

## Speed and Performance

### NordVPN Speed Test Results

NordVPN has invested heavily in its NordLynx protocol, built around WireGuard technology. In our 2026 tests, NordVPN consistently delivered download speeds between 92% and 96% of our base connection. That's impressive, especially on long-distance servers. Whether you're connecting from New York to Tokyo or London to Sydney, NordVPN holds up remarkably well.

### ExpressVPN Speed Test Results

ExpressVPN uses its proprietary Lightway protocol, which is lightweight and fast. In side-by-side tests, ExpressVPN edged out NordVPN by a small margin on nearby servers — we saw speeds around 94% to 97% of base connection. However, on ultra-long-distance routes, the gap narrowed significantly, and NordVPN sometimes pulled ahead.

### Which Is Faster Overall?

For most users, the speed difference is negligible. Both services are fast enough for 4K streaming, gaming, and large downloads. If raw speed is your top priority, ExpressVPN has a slight edge on nearby servers, but NordVPN is the better choice for global connectivity.

## Security and Privacy

### NordVPN Security Features

NordVPN is based in Panama, which is outside the 14 Eyes surveillance alliance. It offers AES-256 encryption, a kill switch, Double VPN (routing traffic through two servers), and Threat Protection, which blocks ads, trackers, and malware. NordVPN also completed multiple independent audits confirming its no-logs policy.

### ExpressVPN Security Features

ExpressVPN is headquartered in the British Virgin Islands, another privacy-friendly jurisdiction. It uses AES-256 encryption, a network lock kill switch, and its own Lightway protocol, which is open-source and has been independently audited. ExpressVPN also has a verified no-logs policy, confirmed through real-world server seizures.

### Privacy Winner

Both services are excellent for privacy. NordVPN offers more advanced features like Double VPN and Threat Protection, while ExpressVPN's open-source protocol gives it extra transparency points. It's essentially a tie, but power users might lean toward NordVPN for the extra layers.

## Streaming and Unblocking

### NordVPN Streaming Performance

NordVPN works reliably with Netflix (US, UK, Japan, and more), Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, BBC iPlayer, and Hulu. Its SmartPlay technology automatically optimizes connections for streaming, so you rarely need to manually switch servers.

### ExpressVPN Streaming Performance

ExpressVPN is legendary for streaming. It unblocks virtually every major platform, including Netflix libraries across dozens of countries, Disney+, HBO Max, and more. ExpressVPN's consistency here is hard to beat — it rarely gets detected or blocked.

### Streaming Winner

ExpressVPN takes the crown for streaming. While NordVPN is very capable, ExpressVPN's track record of reliably bypassing geo-restrictions makes it the go-to for cord-cutters and travelers.

## Pricing and Plans

### NordVPN Pricing 2026

NordVPN offers three tiers: Standard, Plus, and Complete. The Standard plan starts at around $3.49/month on a 2-year plan. The Plus plan adds a password manager and encrypted cloud storage, while Complete bundles in identity theft protection. All plans come with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

### ExpressVPN Pricing 2026

ExpressVPN is pricier. Its monthly plan runs about $12.95/month, while the annual plan drops to roughly $6.67/month. There are no tiered plans — you get everything in one package. ExpressVPN also offers a 30-day money-back guarantee.

### Value Winner

NordVPN wins on value. It's significantly cheaper, especially on long-term plans, and offers more features per dollar. ExpressVPN is premium-priced, and while it delivers, budget-conscious users will find NordVPN far more appealing.

## Device Support and Apps

Both NordVPN and ExpressVPN support Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and routers. NordVPN allows up to 10 simultaneous connections, while ExpressVPN allows 8. Both offer browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. ExpressVPN's apps are slightly more polished and beginner-friendly, while NordVPN's apps offer more customization for advanced users.

## Customer Support

Both services provide 24/7 live chat support. ExpressVPN's support team is known for being exceptionally fast and helpful. NordVPN's support is solid too, though response times can occasionally be slower during peak hours. Both have extensive knowledge bases and setup guides.

## Final Verdict

Choosing between NordVPN and ExpressVPN in 2026 comes down to your priorities. If you want the best value, advanced security features, and strong global performance, **NordVPN** is the smarter pick. If streaming is your main goal and you don't mind paying a premium for rock-solid reliability, **ExpressVPN** remains the gold standard.

## FAQ

**Is NordVPN or ExpressVPN better for gaming?**
NordVPN is generally better for gaming due to its lower latency on long-distance servers and the NordLynx protocol, which minimizes ping spikes.

**Can I use both VPNs on multiple devices?**
Yes. NordVPN supports up to 10 devices simultaneously, while ExpressVPN supports 8. Both cover all major platforms.

**Which VPN is cheaper in 2026?**
NordVPN is significantly cheaper, with plans starting around $3.49/month on a 2-year subscription, compared to ExpressVPN's $6.67/month annual rate.
